visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a grey long-sleeved dress and black knee-high boots, lies on a tan-colored reclining chair. A female staff member in a black t-shirt and beige cap leans over her, adjusting her neck over a white ceramic basin. The setting is a bright, modern indoor space with large glass windows showing a car display area outside. (2) The staff member reclines the chair further, and the woman's head is rested inside the basin. A clear plastic hood sits above. The staff member covers the woman with a striped grey and white blanket as the camera zooms in slightly. (3) The assistant lowers the transparent plastic dome over the woman's head. Inside the dome, red LED lights glow and water starts spraying onto her hair. The woman opens her mouth wide in a laugh and covers her mouth with her hands initially before smiling broadly at the camera. (4) In a close-up, the woman talks animatedly while water jets are seen hitting her scalp inside the transparent dome. She uses her hands outside the blanket to point towards her head, indicating where the water pressure is strongest. White subtitles appear at the bottom center. (5) The scene shifts to a very close-up shot of the woman's face and wet hair. A black and copper-colored professional hair dryer is being held by an off-screen hand to blow-dry her dark hair, with the air visibly moving the wet strands across her face.
